premiseDeviation: The issue text claims 'On main, where the cache exists, it returns fast.' MEASURED FALSE: main (/Volumes/files/src/openclinxr) has NO .openclinxr/evidence/issue-237 cache. The only existing bake cache on this machine is inside the issue-237 worktree (wall-clock/bake-measure.json + bedside-monitor/bake-measure.json, both verdict mesh_exported, plus isolation-report.json). The defect is real and WIDER than described: the default suite reaches the live-bake spawn path in every tree except the issue-237 worktree. The core premise (default suite + gitignored cache -> re-bake from scratch) is confirmed.
ambientFailureClass: gitignored-cache-dependent live bake. .openclinxr/ is gitignored (.gitignore:9), so the bake cache under .openclinxr/evidence/issue-237/ is absent by design in every git worktree. spawnPythonBake() checks existsSync(bake-measure.json) at trellis-metal-subject-isolation.ts:191; absent cache falls through to execFile(VENV_PYTHON, run_bake_isolated.py, ...) at :228 with a 60-min-per-subject timeout (3_600_000, :237). The test file runs two it() blocks with 10_800_000 ms (3h) timeouts calling inspectTrellisMetalSubjectIsolation(). Measured bake cost for one subject (wall-clock cache record): shape gen 254.1s + export 1557.1s, 929293 tris, 35,564,248 bytes raw.

decisionInput: Fix = gate the live bake behind an explicit opt-in env var (TRELLIS_LIVE_BAKE_OPT_IN=1), keep report-reading assertions ungated, keep the counterweight (opt-in still reaches the bake), prove the wiring with an injected runner so no test path can spawn.
